title: ECHO: Emergent Common-Mode Hidden Offsets Drive Vocabulary Collapse in Preference Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.29410v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Preference optimization can improve every ranking metric while building a hidden, shared representation shift that the relative loss barely sees, one that can eventually destroy generation. We trace this failure to the common-mode offset, a shared directional shift in the model's hidden states that appears across token positions, prompts, and both chosen and rejected responses. Because it moves chosen and rejected representations together, the relative ranking loss barely reacts to its accumulation. As this offset grows, it projects onto the output layer to form a vocabulary well, elevating a single token's probability until it dominates decoding and causes generation collapse. The isolated offset alone reconstructs the vocabulary well, injecting the learned offset into an untreated base model recreates the collapse where norm-matched random directions do not, and masking this common component from the loss prevents the well in our flags

translated_title: ECHO：涌现的共模隐藏偏移驱动偏好优化中的词表坍缩
translated_abstract: 偏好优化可以在改善所有排序指标的同时，积累一种相对损失几乎无法察觉的隐藏共享表征偏移，而这种偏移最终可能破坏模型的生成能力。我们将这种失败追溯到“共模偏移”，即模型隐藏状态中出现的一种共享方向性偏移，它出现在不同的词元位置、提示词以及被选择和被拒绝的回复之中。由于它使被选择和被拒绝的表征一同移动，相对排序损失对其积累几乎没有反应。随着这种偏移不断增长，它会投影到输出层形成“词表井”，使单个词元的概率持续升高，直至主导解码过程并导致生成坍缩。实验表明：仅这一孤立的偏移就足以重建词表井；将学习到的偏移注入未经处理的基座模型可以重现这种坍缩，而范数匹配的随机方向则不能；从损失中屏蔽这一共同成分则可以防止词表井的形成。
tldr: 本文发现偏好优化中存在一种相对损失无法察觉的共模隐藏偏移，它会在输出层形成“词表井”，使单一词元概率主导解码并最终导致生成坍缩。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that preference optimization builds a hidden common-mode offset that the relative loss cannot detect, which projects into a "vocabulary well" in the output layer, elevating a single token until it dominates decoding and causes generation collapse.
